item.title: From high-flying AI stocks to tariff-hit alcohol companies, the midterms shook up Wall Street
item.description: The overwhelming victory by the Democrats in the midterm elections shook up Wall Street this week. The biggest tremors were felt in shares of companies tied to the boom in artificial intelligence on concerns that a Democratic Congress will put the brakes on further development of data centers.

item.title: Scott Colom and Black Mississippians stand on the cusp of Senate history as vote count stretches on
item.description: Democrat Scott Colom hasn't won Mississippi’s U.S. Senate race, but the local prosecutor was welcomed as a historic figure as he strolled through the Jackson business district where civil rights leaders once organized.

item.title: Young voters overwhelmingly backed Democrats this year. The question is whether they'll stay
item.description: Young voters voted overwhelmingly for Democrats in the midterm elections, driven by economic concerns and disillusionment with President Donald Trump’s war in Iran.
